## Context / Problem
FP verification over all 348 historical G7 findings (recorded on ticket 696a-82a4-47c5-4e54, research round 3 + operator decisions): at priority >= 0.85, 0 clearly-incorrect findings (22 CORRECT / 7 UNCLEAR across >= 0.75), with direct evidence authors revised plans in the demanded direction within minutes. The 0.80-0.85 band is empty (priorities quantize), so 0.85 selects the same historical set as 0.80 with less future exposure. G7 has never blocked because its routing entry carries default_posture "advisory" @ 0.95 (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, "G7") — a configuration artifact, the same shape the bfa8 T3/T10 enablement (commit e3962d21e) and the c97a T5c enablement (commit 623d68c4a) corrected. Two noise shapes must be fixed in the same change: an unresolvable parent is emitted as a finding instead of an abstain (observed on ticket 18f9), and same-issue duplicates stack (ticket 76d2 carried 3 findings for one contradicted parent clause). Only 3 historical findings carry plan-v4 kind grades yet — see the Monitoring note (deliberately not an AC).

## Approach
Follows the landed bfa8/c97a pattern exactly: a routing flip + rubric guidance, no pass3_decide changes, no new machinery.

(1) Routing (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, "G7" entry): block_threshold 0.95 -> 0.85, default_posture "advisory" -> "blocking". Plan-review blocking derives ONLY from default_posture == "blocking" plus block_threshold — src/rebar/llm/criteria/model.py:73-77 (threshold_for, gate="plan_review"); the blocking_enabled field is the code-review gate's convention and is inert in plan review. A finding then blocks in Pass-3 when priority = validity x impact >= 0.85 (src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py:588, pass3_decide), threaded through the plan-review wrapper src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py:756-771 (impact_fn=impact_plan).

(2) Kind scoping — provided by the EXISTING plan-v4 grading, stated exactly; no per-grade Pass-3 gate exists and none is added. G7 maps its severity onto the divergent_implementation axis (src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_G7.md, kind-mapping paragraph), which impact_plan grades by DIVERGENCE KIND (src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py:350-357 DIVERGENCE_GRADE01/_DIVERGENCE_FLOOR_GRADES; ADR 0054, commit 7d846e0c9): contradicts_reality and omits_required_site score 1.0 and hard-floor impact at 0.85 (decide.py:407-409); incomplete_enumeration contributes 0.55 (DIVERGENCE_INCOMPLETE_CONTRIB, pinned strictly below every blocking block_threshold by tests/unit/test_divergence_grade_split.py:142 — note decide.py's inline comment misattributes this pin to test_impact_plan.py, which pins only UNDERSPECIFIED_ORACLE_CONTRIB; the plan cites the real pin) and NEVER floors, so a cosmetic divergence cannot reach the 0.85 bar through this axis. Consequence, stated as the mechanism actually behaves: blocking @ 0.85 admits BOTH floor-grade kinds — contradicts_reality AND omits_required_site — at validity >= 0.85; an incomplete_enumeration-graded finding cannot block via the divergence axis. Restricting blocking to contradicts_reality alone (this ticket's original framing) would require per-grade gating that pass3_decide/threshold_for do not have; that machinery is REJECTED because (a) the landed precedents scope by guidance not machinery, (b) the FP evidence is kind-blind — 0 clearly-incorrect across ALL 348 historical findings at >= 0.85, so it supports blocking the whole band, and (c) ADR 0054 deliberately gives omits_required_site the floor (an omitted required site is the exact harm class the grading exists to catch), while the rubric fixes in (3) remove the known omission-side FP shapes (sibling handoff, closed parent). A one-sentence rubric guidance (the bfa8 T10 pattern) reinforces the kind mapping: only a genuine contract contradiction or a provably required omission is a floor kind; cosmetic/wording mismatches are incomplete_enumeration — coached, never auto-blocked.

(3) Rubric fixes (src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_G7.md):
- FAIL-OPEN (abstain-with-coverage), the T13/T14 pattern (see src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T14.md FAIL-OPEN paragraph): a parent that cannot be resolved via show_ticket ABSTAINS with a covered-but-unverified note — never a finding.
- CLOSED parent: its contract is checked against its FINAL (as-closed) state, and scope the parent explicitly handed to sibling tickets is NOT a leaf violation (consistent narrowing remains a non-finding).
- DEDUP-AT-SOURCE, the c97a T5c pattern (src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T5c.md "DEDUP-AT-SOURCE"): emit at most ONE finding per contradicted parent clause; additional manifestations fold into that finding's evidence. Rubric-only: the deterministic discovery-stage dedup (src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py:252-284, dedup_key/suppress_and_dedup) collapses only identical (criteria, location, body) triples and cannot recognize same-clause paraphrases, and no LLM-free same-clause detector is feasible — so decide.py is deliberately NOT touched (dropped from this ticket's earlier scope).

(4) Tests and pins: all THREE pinned blocking-set assertions gain G7 — tests/unit/test_threshold_recalibration.py EXPECTED_ROUTING ("G7": (0.85, "blocking")) and the blocking-set assertion at test_only_the_approved_and_prerequisite_criteria_are_blocking — G7 enters via a NEW `G7_BLOCKING = {"G7": 0.85}` constant added to the set-union expression (`... | set(PILOT_BLOCKING) | set(G7_BLOCKING) | ...`); G7 is deliberately NOT added to PILOT_BLOCKING because test_routing_posture_blocking_at_090 parametrizes over that dict asserting block_threshold == 0.90 — and tests/unit/test_impact_model_versioning.py _PLAN_REVIEW_APPROVED_BLOCKING. Additionally tests/unit/test_plan_review_g7.py::test_g7_posture_is_advisory_at_0_95 hard-asserts the OLD posture (default_posture 'advisory', block_threshold 0.95) and is renamed/updated to test_g7_posture_is_blocking_at_085 asserting the new (0.85, 'blocking') pair. New tests/unit/plan_review/test_g7_blocking.py follows tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py: findings driven through the REAL orchestrator.pass3_over_findings wrapper with the REAL impact_plan (no impact monkeypatch — the kind grades themselves produce the impact).

(5) Regenerate docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md via `python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide` and commit the output.

Alternatives rejected: 0.80 threshold (admits future validity-0.80 findings with no historical quality evidence; the 0.80-0.85 band is empty so 0.85 loses nothing); per-grade Pass-3 gating (new cross-gate kernel machinery for a restriction the evidence does not demand — see (2)).

Monitoring note (explicitly NOT an acceptance criterion): re-run the FP classification once >= 20 kind-graded G7 findings have accumulated in the REVIEW_RESULT corpus; the zero-LLM criterion-effectiveness recorder already tracks blocking outcomes (same monitoring stance as the bfa8 pilot). Record the recheck on this ticket's close notes.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json (G7 entry only), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_G7.md, tests/unit/plan_review/test_g7_blocking.py (new), tests/unit/test_threshold_recalibration.py, tests/unit/test_impact_model_versioning.py, tests/unit/test_plan_review_g7.py (posture pin updated), docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md (regenerated). NOT touched: src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py, src/rebar/llm/criteria/model.py, the verifier prompts.

## Testing
`.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/plan_review/test_g7_blocking.py tests/unit/test_threshold_recalibration.py tests/unit/test_impact_model_versioning.py tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py tests/unit/test_impact_plan.py tests/unit/test_divergence_grade_split.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_g7.py -v`, then the full `tests/unit` suite. Cases: threshold_for(["G7"], registry.by_id(), gate="plan_review") == (0.85, True); a G7 finding graded contradicts_reality with an all-yes graded binary BLOCKS (impact 1.0, priority 1.0); the same finding marked self_revealing floors to impact 0.85 -> priority 0.85 -> BLOCKS (exact-boundary case, priority >= block_threshold); omits_required_site all-yes BLOCKS (floor kind, pinned deliberately); incomplete_enumeration all-yes lands impact 0.55 / priority 0.55 -> ADVISORY; a floor-kind finding at validity 0.8889 with self-revealing impact 0.85 -> priority 0.7556 -> ADVISORY (the validity guard); rubric-text assertions for the abstain-with-coverage, closed-parent + sibling-handoff, one-per-clause dedup, and floor-kind guidance sentences.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] criteria_routing.json "G7" carries default_posture "blocking" with block_threshold 0.85 (checked: test_g7_blocking.py asserts threshold_for(["G7"], registry.by_id(), gate="plan_review") == (0.85, True)).
- [ ] Through the real plan-review Pass-3 wrapper with the real impact_plan, a contradicts_reality-graded G7 finding at validity 1.0 BLOCKS (checked: test_g7_blocking.py).
- [ ] Through the same wrapper, an omits_required_site-graded G7 finding at validity 1.0 BLOCKS (checked: test_g7_blocking.py).
- [ ] Through the same wrapper, an incomplete_enumeration-graded G7 finding stays ADVISORY at priority 0.55 (checked: test_g7_blocking.py).
- [ ] The G7 rubric contains each of the four new rule sentences: abstain-on-unresolvable-parent (never a finding); closed-parent-final-state + sibling-handoff; one-finding-per-contradicted-parent-clause; floor-kind guidance (checked: one rubric-text assertion per sentence in test_g7_blocking.py).
- [ ] The pinned routing table, the pinned blocking-set union (via the new G7_BLOCKING constant), the _PLAN_REVIEW_APPROVED_BLOCKING set, and the test_plan_review_g7.py posture pin each reflect G7 at (0.85, "blocking") (checked: test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, test_plan_review_g7.py all pass).
- [ ] docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md is regenerated (checked: `python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide` produces no diff on the committed tree).
